layout.grouping: Separated upper text and lower image streams converge in adjacent matrices; colour also associates modality sides. Labels/entities are shown in a separate left construction area.
layout.transfer: Name row/column modality and separate target from prediction before choosing a matrix layout; use explicit computations to clarify the central loss.
layout.omissions: Projection heads, unit normalization, softmax axes, batch-unit details and optimization stages need methods/code. Figure3 itself does not establish a full data sampler, patient-independent cohort or deployed inference inputs.
layout.original_assets: Radiograph thumbnails inspected only as part of original whole figure; no clinical interpretation or copied image pixels in new diagrams.

conflicts_and_scope.symbols: Figure3 Text Encoder→v and Image Encoder→t oppose §3.1 definitions. Redraw uses explicit modality names.
conflicts_and_scope.axis: Eq4 normalizes image i over text j, while printed Eq7 denominator uses i. Pinned losses.py:74–84 uses row normalization for both target/prediction and transposes score matrices for reverse direction. This establishes that code subpath, not the publication run.
conflicts_and_scope.label_operator: Paper Eq3 cosine versus pinned losses.py:49 direct dot product. dataset.py:349–355 stacks labels without normalization in the inspected path; comment about clamp at losses.py:71 is not an executed clamp.
conflicts_and_scope.sampling: Paper §3.3 says separately sampled modalities; pinned dataset.py:192–216 samples a sentence from the same row report when available, else230–248 samples label-conditioned prompts. Whole-batch combinations do not imply two statistically independent samplers.
conflicts_and_scope.code_branches: Only both-labels-present, no-text-augmentation soft-loss subpath is drawn. Missing-label hard loss, default augmentation and deployment are outside scope.
conflicts_and_scope.execution: Six source files read statically; no model, labels, training CSV, weights or original research code executed/downloaded. Fixed commit9c3396f is not established as the published run.
